display-name: SAP S/4HANA Credit Memo Request API
description: The SAP S/4HANA Sales connector provides APIs that enable seamless integration with the [Credit Memo Request (A2X) API v1.0.0](https://api.sap.com/api/API_CREDIT_MEMO_REQUEST_SRV/overview). The service allows to create, read, update, and delete credit memo requests, including their items, partners, pricing elements, and texts.
key-features: Create, read, update, and delete credit memo requests in SAP S/4HANA
Seamless integration with the Credit Memo Request (A2X) API v1.0.0
Support for basic and OAuth 2.0 authentication
Manage items, partners, pricing elements, and texts, and release or reject approval requests
